summary: Account limits break ties by the canonical claim order, so every node folds the same seat bindings and readings from the same harness.limits claims

replay.detail: No graph replay. The limits projection version moves from 1 to 2: on the first start with this build the two local limits tables are dropped and refilled from harness.limits claims by the existing bounded background catch-up. Until that fill finishes, the limits read returns nothing, as on any limits projection rebuild.

schema.detail: Local tables only: account_limit_readings and account_limit_seats gain a head_key column holding each claim's canonical key, and keep version 1's columns. They stay outside shared projections and digests. Storage version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. Where two harness.limits claims tie on accepted time (seat binding) or on every reading field (reading selection), the winner is now the canonical newest claim instead of the one this node happened to admit last.

downtime.detail: The refill runs after open in bounded pages and adds no startup time.

recovery.detail: A build with limits projection version 1 that opens the store empties the tables and refills them with its own statements, which the kept columns still accept; this build does the same in reverse.
